metadata.name: sheetkeys.hash
metadata.description: (state, seg, exclude?) -> hex SHA-256 of segment `seg`'s SOURCE cels (ValueCel value | FormulaCel formula-text), sorted by key, excluding `exclude` patterns (array or comma-string; trailing * = prefix). Derived FormulaCel values are inherently excluded (sources only). Deterministic across replicas. Used by =hash, sealsheet, and the change pipeline.
